units.source_text: 没过多久，照子回来了，看见姐姐，她兴奋的抓着姐姐的手不舍放开，信子激动的笑出眼泪来。

en.t: Before long, Teruko came back. When she saw her older sister, she excitedly clutched her hand and would not let go, while Nobuko was so moved that she laughed through tears.

units.source_text: 一时间，两个人忘了俊吉的存在，你一言我一语的问对方去年分别以后的生活情况。

en.t: For a while, the two of them forgot Shunkichi was even there and eagerly asked each other about their lives since they had parted the previous year.

units.source_text: 照子神采飞扬，脸上带着红晕，告诉姐姐她还在养鸡。

en.t: Teruko was glowing with energy, a flush on her face, and told her sister that she was still raising chickens.

units.source_text: 俊吉抽着烟，望着激动的两个姐妹，心满意足的微笑。

en.t: Shunkichi smoked as he watched the two excited sisters, smiling with deep satisfaction.
